name: Kunoichi Onee-san Shizune no Gohoushi Ninmu ~Sessha no Subete wa Waka-sama no Mono Suteki na Kodane de Oyotsugi o Sazukete Kudasai~
original_name: くのいちお姉さん静音のご奉仕任務 ～拙者の全ては若様のもの素敵な子種でお世継ぎを授けてください～
source:
The protagonist, Toshiya Makabe, is your average, everyday student.
On the day of the school entrance ceremony, Toshiya is approached by his childhood friend and upperclassman, Shizune Kakei, who says she has something important to discuss.
That night, as Toshiya waits nervously, Shizune shows up—dressed in full kunoichi attire!
The Kakei family has served the Makabe family as a clan of shinobi for generations. Shizune explains that, to continue the family line, she needs Toshiya to help her conceive a child.
And just like that, Toshiya’s life of making babies with his kunoichi childhood friend begins!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055617.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主角真壁敏也是一名普通的普通学生。
入学典礼当天，他的儿时好友、高年级学生秣静静找到了俊哉，并说她有重要的事情要讨论。
那天晚上，正当俊也紧张地等待时，穿着全套女忍衣的静音出现了！
嘉庆家族作为忍者家族世世代代侍奉真壁家族。静音解释说，为了延续家族的血脉，她需要敏也帮助她怀孕。
就这样，俊也和女忍儿青梅竹马的生孩子生活开始了！
